candidates.label: Theorem 1.1

candidates.heading: Theorem 1.1 (Irrationality on large admissible Hassett divisors).
candidates.statement: There is an integer d0 such that, for every admissible d > d0, a very general cubic fourfold X in Cd is irrational and admits an exact C-linear equivalence Ku(X) ≃ Db (Coh S) for a smooth projective K3 surface S.

candidates.heading: Corollary 1.2 (Failure of associated-K3 sufficiency).

Here L⊥ ⊂ H2(SHdg, Z), and the surface cup pairing is reversed. Thus an associated untwisted polarized K3 surface in this Hodge-theoretic sense is not sufficient for rationality.

candidates.heading: Theorem 4.3 (Bounded data exclude large K3 degrees).
candidates.statement: Fix the finite-type families occurring in each of the following statements, and fix an integer N ≥ 1. candidates.statement: The comparison endomorphism of Proposition 5.3 is G = Id. Consequently, for every x ∈ R3 and every nonzero null vector θ, M1,θ = M2,θ on Eθ. (6.4)
